body.en: Advanced trigonometry constitutes approximately 15% of the EST II Math Level 1 exam. Topics span beyond basic right triangles into radians and circular functions, Pythagorean and double-angle identities, solving trigonometric equations over \([0, 2\pi)\), Law of Sines and Law of Cosines applications, and sinusoidal function modeling (\(y = A\sin(Bx - C) + D\)).
body.ar: Advanced حساب المثلثات constitutes approximately 15% of the EST II Math Level 1 exam. Topics span beyond basic right triangles into radians and circular الدوال, Pythagorean and double-الزاوية المتطابقات, solving trigonometric المعادلات over \([0, 2\pi)\), Law of Sines and Law of Cosines applications, and sinusoidal الدالة modeling (\(y = A\sin(Bx - C) + D\)).

label.en: Definition 5.1 — Radians, Circular Coordinates, and Reciprocal Functions
label.ar: تعريف 5.1 — Radians, Circular الإحداثيات, and Reciprocal الدوال

body.en:
Foundational trigonometric definitions on the coordinate plane:
  • Radian Conversion: Angle measure where arc length equals radius on a circle:
    \[ \pi\text{ radians} = 180^\circ \implies 1\text{ rad} = \frac{180^\circ}{\pi}, \quad 1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180^\circ}\text{ rad} \]
  • Unit Circle Coordinates: For any angle \(\theta\) in standard position on the circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 1\):
    \[ x = \cos\theta, \qquad y = \sin\theta, \qquad \tan\theta = \frac{y}{x} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} \]
  • Reciprocal Trigonometric Functions:
    \[ \csc\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta}, \qquad \sec\theta = \frac{1}{\cos\theta}, \qquad \cot\theta = \frac{1}{\tan\theta} = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \]
  • Signs of Trigonometric Functions (ASTC Rule):
    Quadrant I (All positive), Quadrant II (Sine positive), Quadrant III (Tangent positive), Quadrant IV (Cosine positive).
body.ar:
Foundational trigonometric definitions on the الإحداثي plane:
  • Radian Conversion: الزاوية measure حيث arc length equals نصف القطر on a الدائرة:
    \[ \pi\text{ radians} = 180^\circ \implies 1\text{ rad} = \frac{180^\circ}{\pi}, \quad 1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180^\circ}\text{ rad} \]
  • Unit الدائرة الإحداثيات: For any الزاوية \(\theta\) in standard position on the الدائرة \(x^2 + y^2 = 1\):
    \[ x = \cos\theta, \qquad y = \sin\theta, \qquad \tan\theta = \frac{y}{x} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} \]
  • Reciprocal Trigonometric الدوال:
    \[ \csc\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta}, \qquad \sec\theta = \frac{1}{\cos\theta}, \qquad \cot\theta = \frac{1}{\tan\theta} = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \]
  • Signs of Trigonometric الدوال (ASTC Rule):
    Quadrant I (All positive), Quadrant II (Sine positive), Quadrant III (Tangent positive), Quadrant IV (Cosine positive).

body.en: Unit Circle Periodicity, Harmonic Synthesis & Triangle Laws: Every angle \(\theta\) on the unit circle defines \((\cos\theta, \sin\theta)\) with fundamental Pythagorean invariance \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta \equiv 1\). Linear combinations of同-frequency waves \(a\cos\theta \pm b\sin\theta\) collapse into a single phase-shifted sinusoid \(R\cos(\theta \mp \alpha)\) where \(R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\) and \(\tan\alpha = b/a\), immediately revealing the exact maximum \(+R\) and minimum \(-R\).
body.ar: Unit الدائرة Periodicity, Harmonic Synthesis & المثلث Laws: Every الزاوية \(\theta\) on the unit الدائرة defines \((\cos\theta, \sin\theta)\) with fundamental Pythagorean invariance \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta \equiv 1\). Linear combinations of同-frequency waves \(a\cos\theta \pm b\sin\theta\) collapse into a single phase-shifted sinusoid \(R\cos(\theta \mp \alpha)\) حيث \(R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\) and \(\tan\alpha = b/a\), immediately revealing the exact maximum \(+R\) and minimum \(-R\).

label.en: Theorem 5.1 — Trigonometric Identities and Sinusoidal Wave Parameters
label.ar: مبرهنة 5.1 — Trigonometric المتطابقات and Sinusoidal Wave المعاملات

body.en:
Analytical identities and graph transformation parameters:
  • Pythagorean Identities:
    1. \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\)
    2. \(1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta\)
    3. \(1 + \cot^2\theta = \csc^2\theta\)
  • Double-Angle Identities:
    1. \(\sin(2\theta) = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta\)
    2. \(\cos(2\theta) = \cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 2\cos^2\theta - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\)
    3. \(\tan(2\theta) = \frac{2\tan\theta}{1 - \tan^2\theta}\)
  • Sinusoidal Function Anatomy: For \(y = A \sin(B(x - C)) + D\) or \(y = A \cos(B(x - C)) + D\):
    1. Amplitude: \(|A| = \frac{y_{\max} - y_{\min}}{2}\).
    2. Period: \(T = \frac{2\pi}{|B|}\) (for tangent, period is \(\frac{\pi}{|B|}\)).
    3. Phase Shift (Horizontal Shift): \(C\) (right if \(C > 0\), left if \(C < 0\)).
    4. Midline / Vertical Shift: \(y = D = \frac{y_{\max} + y_{\min}}{2}\).
body.ar:
Analytical المتطابقات and التمثيل البياني transformation المعاملات:
  • Pythagorean المتطابقات:
    1. \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\)
    2. \(1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta\)
    3. \(1 + \cot^2\theta = \csc^2\theta\)
  • Double-الزاوية المتطابقات:
    1. \(\sin(2\theta) = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta\)
    2. \(\cos(2\theta) = \cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 2\cos^2\theta - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\)
    3. \(\tan(2\theta) = \frac{2\tan\theta}{1 - \tan^2\theta}\)
  • Sinusoidal الدالة Anatomy: For \(y = A \sin(B(x - C)) + D\) or \(y = A \cos(B(x - C)) + D\):
    1. Amplitude: \(|A| = \frac{y_{\max} - y_{\min}}{2}\).
    2. Period: \(T = \frac{2\pi}{|B|}\) (for tangent, period is \(\frac{\pi}{|B|}\)).
    3. Phase Shift (Horizontal Shift): \(C\) (right if \(C > 0\), left if \(C < 0\)).
    4. Midline / Vertical Shift: \(y = D = \frac{y_{\max} + y_{\min}}{2}\).

label.en: ▲ EST II Math Traps & Pitfalls — Trigonometry & Angle Measures
label.ar: ▲ EST II Math Traps & Pitfalls — حساب المثلثات & الزاوية Measures

body.en:
• Radian vs. Degree Calculator Mode: EST II problems frequently present angles in radians (e.g., \(5\pi/6\)) alongside degree options or vice versa. Always check your calculator's active mode before computing numerical values.
  • Double-Angle Identity Selection: \(\cos(2\theta)\) has three identities: \(\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta\), \(2\cos^2\theta - 1\), and \(1 - 2\sin^2\theta\). In equations containing \(\sin\theta\), choose \(1 - 2\sin^2\theta\) to produce a single-variable quadratic in sine; in equations containing \(\cos\theta\), choose \(2\cos^2\theta - 1\).
  • Quadrant Signs (ASTC Rule): Remember: All positive in Q I; Sine positive in Q II; Tangent positive in Q III; Cosine positive in Q IV. For \(\sin\theta = -1/2\), the solutions lie strictly in Quadrants III and IV.
  • Range of Inverse Trigonometric Functions: Standard principal value ranges: \(\arcsin x \in [-\pi/2, \pi/2]\), \(\arccos x \in [0, \pi]\), and \(\arctan x \in (-\pi/2, \pi/2)\). Calculator evaluations will return only the principal value.
body.ar:
• Radian vs. Degree Calculator Mode: EST II problems frequently present angles in radians (e.g., \(5\pi/6\)) alongside degree options or vice versa. Always check your calculator's active mode before computing numerical values.
  • Double-الزاوية المتطابقة Selection: \(\cos(2\theta)\) has three المتطابقات: \(\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta\), \(2\cos^2\theta - 1\), and \(1 - 2\sin^2\theta\). In المعادلات containing \(\sin\theta\), choose \(1 - 2\sin^2\theta\) to produce a single-المتغير quadratic in sine; in المعادلات containing \(\cos\theta\), choose \(2\cos^2\theta - 1\).
  • Quadrant Signs (ASTC Rule): Remember: All positive in Q I; Sine positive in Q II; Tangent positive in Q III; Cosine positive in Q IV. For \(\sin\theta = -1/2\), the الحلول lie strictly in Quadrants III and IV.
  • Range of Inverse Trigonometric الدوال: Standard principal value ranges: \(\arcsin x \in [-\pi/2, \pi/2]\), \(\arccos x \in [0, \pi]\), and \(\arctan x \in (-\pi/2, \pi/2)\). Calculator evaluations will return only the principal value.

label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (حساب المثلثات)

body.en:
Why the Harmonic \(R\)-Formula & Cosine Rule Hold: Expanding \(R\cos(\theta - \alpha)\) via the compound-angle identity gives:

\[ R\cos(\theta - \alpha) = (R\cos\alpha)\cos\theta + (R\sin\alpha)\sin\theta \]

Matching coefficients with \(a\cos\theta + b\sin\theta\) requires \(R\cos\alpha = a\) and \(R\sin\alpha = b\). Squaring and adding yields \(R^2(\cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha) = a^2 + b^2 \implies R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\), and dividing gives \(\tan\alpha = \dfrac{b}{a}\).
body.ar:
Why the Harmonic \(R\)-الصيغة & Cosine Rule Hold: Expanding \(R\cos(\theta - \alpha)\) via the compound-الزاوية المتطابقة gives:

\[ R\cos(\theta - \alpha) = (R\cos\alpha)\cos\theta + (R\sin\alpha)\sin\theta \]

Matching المعاملات with \(a\cos\theta + b\sin\theta\) requires \(R\cos\alpha = a\) and \(R\sin\alpha = b\). Squaring and adding yields \(R^2(\cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha) = a^2 + b^2 \implies R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\), and dividing gives \(\tan\alpha = \dfrac{b}{a}\).

body.en:
Verify and simplify the trigonometric identity \(\dfrac{\sin(2\theta)}{1 + \cos(2\theta)}\).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Substitute double-angle identity for \(\sin(2\theta)\):
    \[ \sin(2\theta) = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta \]
  2. Choose the appropriate double-angle identity for \(\cos(2\theta)\):
    Use \(\cos(2\theta) = 2\cos^2\theta - 1\) to cancel the constant 1 in the denominator:
    \[ 1 + \cos(2\theta) = 1 + (2\cos^2\theta - 1) = 2\cos^2\theta \]
  3. Simplify the rational fraction:
    \[ \frac{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{2\cos^2\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \mathbf{\tan\theta} \]
The expression simplifies to \(\mathbf{\tan\theta}\).
body.ar:
Verify and بسّط the trigonometric المتطابقة \(\dfrac{\sin(2\theta)}{1 + \cos(2\theta)}\).

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Substitute double-الزاوية المتطابقة for \(\sin(2\theta)\):
    \[ \sin(2\theta) = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta \]
  2. Choose the appropriate double-الزاوية المتطابقة for \(\cos(2\theta)\):
    Use \(\cos(2\theta) = 2\cos^2\theta - 1\) to cancel the الثابت 1 in the denominator:
    \[ 1 + \cos(2\theta) = 1 + (2\cos^2\theta - 1) = 2\cos^2\theta \]
  3. Simplify the rational fraction:
    \[ \frac{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{2\cos^2\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \mathbf{\tan\theta} \]
The العبارة الجبرية simplifies to \(\mathbf{\tan\theta}\).

label.en: Worked Example 5.B — Solving Trigonometric Equations in \([0, 2\pi)\)
label.ar: مثال محلول 5.B — Solving Trigonometric المعادلات in \([0, 2\pi)\)

body.en:
Solve the equation \(2\cos^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0\) for all solutions in the interval \(0 \le \theta < 2\pi\).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Convert to a single trigonometric function:
    Use \(\cos^2\theta = 1 - \sin^2\theta\):
    \[ 2(1 - \sin^2\theta) + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \implies 2 - 2\sin^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \]
    \[ -2\sin^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 1 = 0 \implies 2\sin^2\theta - 3\sin\theta + 1 = 0 \]
  2. Factor the quadratic in \(\sin\theta\):
    \[ (2\sin\theta - 1)(\sin\theta - 1) = 0 \]
  3. Solve each factor:
    Case 1: \(2\sin\theta - 1 = 0 \implies \sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\).
    Sine is positive in Quadrants I and II with reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\):
    \[ \theta_1 = \frac{\pi}{6}, \qquad \theta_2 = \pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6} \]
    Case 2: \(\sin\theta - 1 = 0 \implies \sin\theta = 1\).
    In \([0, 2\pi)\), \(\sin\theta = 1\) occurs at:
    \[ \theta_3 = \frac{\pi}{2} \]
The complete solution set is \(\mathbf{\left\{ \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{6} \right\}}\).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة \(2\cos^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0\) for all الحلول in the interval \(0 \le \theta < 2\pi\).

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Convert to a single trigonometric الدالة:
    Use \(\cos^2\theta = 1 - \sin^2\theta\):
    \[ 2(1 - \sin^2\theta) + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \implies 2 - 2\sin^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \]
    \[ -2\sin^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 1 = 0 \implies 2\sin^2\theta - 3\sin\theta + 1 = 0 \]
  2. Factor the quadratic in \(\sin\theta\):
    \[ (2\sin\theta - 1)(\sin\theta - 1) = 0 \]
  3. Solve each factor:
    Case 1: \(2\sin\theta - 1 = 0 \implies \sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\).
    Sine is positive in Quadrants I and II with reference الزاوية \(\frac{\pi}{6}\):
    \[ \theta_1 = \frac{\pi}{6}, \qquad \theta_2 = \pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6} \]
    Case 2: \(\sin\theta - 1 = 0 \implies \sin\theta = 1\).
    In \([0, 2\pi)\), \(\sin\theta = 1\) occurs at:
    \[ \theta_3 = \frac{\pi}{2} \]
The complete الحل set is \(\mathbf{\left\{ \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{6} \right\}}\).

label.en: Worked Example 5.C — Sinusoidal Modeling & Characteristic Extraction
label.ar: مثال محلول 5.C — Sinusoidal Modeling & Characteristic Extraction

body.en:
A sinusoidal wave has a maximum point at \((2, 9)\) and the subsequent minimum point at \((8, 1)\).
(a) Find the amplitude, midline, and period.
(b) Write a cosine formula of the form \(y = A\cos(B(x - C)) + D\).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. (a) Extract parameters:
    1. Midline \(D\): \(D = \frac{y_{\max} + y_{\min}}{2} = \frac{9 + 1}{2} = \mathbf{5}\).
    2. Amplitude \(A\): \(A = \frac{y_{\max} - y_{\min}}{2} = \frac{9 - 1}{2} = \mathbf{4}\).
    3. Half-period is the horizontal distance between max and min: \(\frac{T}{2} = 8 - 2 = 6\implies T = \mathbf{12}\).
    4. Frequency coefficient \(B\): \(B = \frac{2\pi}{T} = \frac{2\pi}{12} = \mathbf{\frac{\pi}{6}}\).
  2. (b) Cosine model:
    Since a peak occurs at \(x = 2\), choose phase shift \(C = 2\):
    \[ y = \mathbf{4 \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}(x - 2)\right) + 5} \]
body.ar:
A sinusoidal wave has a maximum point at \((2, 9)\) and the subsequent minimum point at \((8, 1)\).
(a) أوجد amplitude, midline, and period.
(b) Write a cosine الصيغة of the form \(y = A\cos(B(x - C)) + D\).

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. (a) Extract المعاملات:
    1. Midline \(D\): \(D = \frac{y_{\max} + y_{\min}}{2} = \frac{9 + 1}{2} = \mathbf{5}\).
    2. Amplitude \(A\): \(A = \frac{y_{\max} - y_{\min}}{2} = \frac{9 - 1}{2} = \mathbf{4}\).
    3. Half-period is the horizontal distance between max and min: \(\frac{T}{2} = 8 - 2 = 6\implies T = \mathbf{12}\).
    4. Frequency المعامل \(B\): \(B = \frac{2\pi}{T} = \frac{2\pi}{12} = \mathbf{\frac{\pi}{6}}\).
  2. (b) Cosine model:
    Since a peak occurs at \(x = 2\), choose phase shift \(C = 2\):
    \[ y = \mathbf{4 \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}(x - 2)\right) + 5} \]

question.en: Find all solutions of \(\cos(2\theta) = \cos\theta\) in the interval \(0^\circ \le \theta \le 360^\circ\).
question.ar: أوجد all solutions of \(\cos(2\theta) = \cos\theta\) in the interval \(0^\circ \le \theta \le 360^\circ\).

solution.en:
Step 1: Use double-angle identity: \[ \cos(2\theta) = 2\cos^2\theta - 1 \implies 2\cos^2\theta - 1 = \cos\theta \implies 2\cos^2\theta - \cos\theta - 1 = 0. \]

Step 2: Factor the quadratic: \[ (2\cos\theta + 1)(\cos\theta - 1) = 0. \]

Step 3: Solve factors:

  • \(\cos\theta = 1 \implies \mathbf{\theta = 0^\circ, 360^\circ}\).
  • \(\cos\theta = -\frac{1}{2} \implies\) Reference angle is \(60^\circ\), in Quadrants II and III: \[ \theta = 180^\circ - 60^\circ = \mathbf{120^\circ}, \qquad \theta = 180^\circ + 60^\circ = \mathbf{240^\circ}. \]

The solutions are \(\mathbf{\{0^\circ, 120^\circ, 240^\circ, 360^\circ\}}\).
solution.ar:
Step 1: Use double-angle identity: \[ \cos(2\theta) = 2\cos^2\theta - 1 \implies 2\cos^2\theta - 1 = \cos\theta \implies 2\cos^2\theta - \cos\theta - 1 = 0. \]

Step 2: حلّل the quadratic: \[ (2\cos\theta + 1)(\cos\theta - 1) = 0. \]

Step 3: حل حلّلs:

  • \(\cos\theta = 1 \implies \mathbf{\theta = 0^\circ, 360^\circ}\).
  • \(\cos\theta = -\frac{1}{2} \implies\) Reference angle is \(60^\circ\), in Quadrants II and III: \[ \theta = 180^\circ - 60^\circ = \mathbf{120^\circ}, \qquad \theta = 180^\circ + 60^\circ = \mathbf{240^\circ}. \]

The solutions are \(\mathbf{\{0^\circ, 120^\circ, 240^\circ, 360^\circ\}}\).

question.en: Solve the trigonometric equation \(2\cos^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0\) for all solutions in the interval \(0 \le \theta < 2\pi\).
question.ar: حل the trigonometric equation \(2\cos^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0\) for all solutions in the interval \(0 \le \theta < 2\pi\).

solution.en:
Step 1: Convert to sine: \[ 2(1 - \sin^2\theta) + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \implies 2\sin^2\theta - 3\sin\theta + 1 = 0. \]

Step 2: Factor: \[ (2\sin\theta - 1)(\sin\theta - 1) = 0. \]

Step 3: Solve: \(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2} \implies \theta = \mathbf{\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}}\); \(\sin\theta = 1 \implies \theta = \mathbf{\frac{\pi}{2}}\).

The solution set is \(\mathbf{\left\{ \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{6} \right\}}\).
solution.ar:
Step 1: Convert to sine: \[ 2(1 - \sin^2\theta) + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \implies 2\sin^2\theta - 3\sin\theta + 1 = 0. \]

Step 2: حلّل: \[ (2\sin\theta - 1)(\sin\theta - 1) = 0. \]

Step 3: حل: \(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2} \implies \theta = \mathbf{\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}}\); \(\sin\theta = 1 \implies \theta = \mathbf{\frac{\pi}{2}}\).

The solution set is \(\mathbf{\left\{ \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{6} \right\}}\).

hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(2(1 - \sin^2\theta) + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0 \implies 2\sin^2\theta - 3\sin\theta + 1 = 0\) لتبسيط الخطوة.
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(\mathbf{\left\{ \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{6} \right\}}\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

question.en: A trigonometric function has the formula \(f(x) = -3\sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{2}\right) + 4\). State its: (a) amplitude, (b) period, (c) phase shift, and (d) range.
question.ar: A trigonometric function has the formula \(f(x) = -3\sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{2}\right) + 4\). State its: (a) amplitude, (b) period, (c) phase shإذا كانt, and (d) range.

solution.en:
(a) Amplitude: \(|A| = |-3| = \mathbf{3}\).

(b) Period: Factor \(B = 2\): \[ f(x) = -3\sin\left(2\left(x - \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right) + 4 \implies T = \frac{2\pi}{B} = \frac{2\pi}{2} = \mathbf{\pi}. \]

(c) Phase Shift: Shifted right by \(\mathbf{\frac{\pi}{4}}\).

(d) Range: Minimum is \(D - |A| = 4 - 3 = 1\); maximum is \(D + |A| = 4 + 3 = 7\). Range is \(\mathbf{[1, 7]}\).

question.en: In triangle \(ABC\), \(a = 8\), \(\angle B = 35^\circ\), and \(\angle C = 75^\circ\). Use the Law of Sines to calculate the length of side \(b\) to two decimal places.
question.ar: In triangle \(ABC\), \(a = 8\), \(\angle B = 35^\circ\), and \(\angle C = 75^\circ\). Use the Law of Sines to احسب length of side \(b\) to two منازل عشرية.

solution.en:
Step 1: Find angle \(A\): \[ \angle A = 180^\circ - 35^\circ - 75^\circ = 70^\circ. \]

Step 2: Apply Law of Sines: \[ \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{a}{\sin A} \implies b = \frac{a \sin B}{\sin A} = \frac{8 \sin(35^\circ)}{\sin(70^\circ)}. \]

Step 3: Evaluate: \[ b = \frac{8(0.5736)}{0.9397} = \frac{4.5886}{0.9397} \approx \mathbf{4.88}. \]

label.en: ● Complete Guide to All 6 Trigonometric Ratios — Unit Circle, Reciprocals, Domains, Periods & Asymptotes
label.ar: ● الدليل الشامل للنسب المثلثية الست — دائرة الوحدة والمقلوبات والمجالات والدورات وخطوط التقارب

body.en:
For any angle \( heta\) in standard position whose terminal ray intersects the unit circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 1\) at \(P(\cos heta, \sin heta)\) (or a right triangle with opposite \(o\), adjacent \(a\), and hypotenuse \(h\)), the six trigonometric functions are:

\[ \sin heta = y = rac{o}{h}, \qquad \cos heta = x = rac{a}{h}, \qquad an heta = rac{\sin heta}{\cos heta} = rac{y}{x} = rac{o}{a} \]\[ \csc heta = rac{1}{\sin heta} = rac{h}{o}, \qquad \sec heta = rac{1}{\cos heta} = rac{h}{a}, \qquad \cot heta = rac{\cos heta}{\sin heta} = rac{x}{y} = rac{a}{o} \]
FunctionDomainRangePeriodSymmetryVertical Asymptotes
\(\sin heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)OddNone
\(\cos heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)EvenNone
\( an heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)Odd\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\csc heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)Odd\( heta = k\pi\)
\(\sec heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)Even\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\cot heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)Odd\( heta = k\pi\)

Pythagorean Identities: \(\sin^2 heta + \cos^2 heta = 1\), \(1 + an^2 heta = \sec^2 heta\), and \(1 + \cot^2 heta = \csc^2 heta\).
body.ar:
لأي زاوية \( heta\) في الوضع القياسي يقطع ضلع انتهائها دائرة الوحدة \(x^2 + y^2 = 1\) عند النقطة \(P(\cos heta, \sin heta)\) (أو في مثلث قائم الزاوية بمقابل \(o\) ومجاور \(a\) ووتر \(h\))، تُعرَّف الدوال المثلثية الست كما يلي:

\[ \sin heta = y = rac{o}{h}, \qquad \cos heta = x = rac{a}{h}, \qquad an heta = rac{\sin heta}{\cos heta} = rac{y}{x} = rac{o}{a} \]\[ \csc heta = rac{1}{\sin heta} = rac{h}{o}, \qquad \sec heta = rac{1}{\cos heta} = rac{h}{a}, \qquad \cot heta = rac{\cos heta}{\sin heta} = rac{x}{y} = rac{a}{o} \]
الدالةالمجالالمدىالدورة الأساسيةالتماثلخطوط التقارب الرأسية

\(\cos heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)زوجيةلا يوجد

\(\csc heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)فردية\( heta = k\pi\)
\(\sec heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)زوجية\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\cot heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)فردية\( heta = k\pi\)

متطابقات فيثاغورس المثلثية: \(\sin^2 heta + \cos^2 heta = 1\)، و\(1 + an^2 heta = \sec^2 heta\)، و\(1 + \cot^2 heta = \csc^2 heta\).

label.en: ● All 6 Inverse Trigonometric Functions — Restricted Domains & Principal Ranges
label.ar: ● الدوال المثلثية العكسية الست جميعاً — المجالات المقيدة والمدى الأساسي

body.en:
Because the six trigonometric functions are periodic, they are not one-to-one on \(\mathbb{R}\). Restricting each forward function to its canonical principal branch makes it strictly monotonic so that a unique inverse exists (whose graph is the reflection of the restricted branch across \(y = x\)):

Inverse FunctionEquivalent StatementDomain of \(f^{-1}(x)\)Principal Range (Radians)Unit Circle Quadrants
\(y = \arcsin x = \sin^{-1} x\)\(\sin y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)Quadrants IV & I
\(y = \arccos x = \cos^{-1} x\)\(\cos y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\([0, \pi]\)Quadrants I & II
\(y = \arctan x = \tan^{-1} x\)\(\tan y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)Quadrants IV & I
\(y = \operatorname{arccsc} x = \csc^{-1} x\)\(\csc y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)Quadrants IV & I
\(y = \operatorname{arcsec} x = \sec^{-1} x\)\(\sec y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\)Quadrants I & II
\(y = \operatorname{arccot} x = \cot^{-1} x\)\(\cot y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((0, \pi)\)Quadrants I & II

Reciprocal & Cofunction Identities: \(\operatorname{arccsc}(x) = \arcsin(1/x)\) and \(\operatorname{arcsec}(x) = \arccos(1/x)\) for \(|x| \ge 1\); \(\arcsin x + \arccos x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) and \(\arctan x + \operatorname{arccot} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
body.ar:
نظراً لأن الدوال المثلثية الست دورية، فإنها ليست متباينة (واحداً لواحد) على \(\mathbb{R}\). بتقييد مجال كل دالة إلى فرعها الأساسي تصبح رتيبة تماماً وقابلة للعكس، ويكون تمثيل الدالة العكسية انعكاساً للفرع المقيّد حول المستقيم \(y = x\):

الدالة العكسيةالصيغة المكافئةمجال \(f^{-1}(x)\)المدى الأساسي (بالراديان)أرباع دائرة الوحدة
\(y = \arcsin x = \sin^{-1} x\)\(\sin y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)الربعان الرابع والأول
\(y = \arccos x = \cos^{-1} x\)\(\cos y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\([0, \pi]\)الربعان الأول والثاني
\(y = \arctan x = \tan^{-1} x\)\(\tan y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)الربعان الرابع والأول
\(y = \operatorname{arccsc} x = \csc^{-1} x\)\(\csc y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)الربعان الرابع والأول
\(y = \operatorname{arcsec} x = \sec^{-1} x\)\(\sec y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\)الربعان الأول والثاني
\(y = \operatorname{arccot} x = \cot^{-1} x\)\(\cot y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((0, \pi)\)الربعان الأول والثاني

متطابقات المقلوبات والدوال المتممة: \(\operatorname{arccsc}(x) = \arcsin(1/x)\) و\(\operatorname{arcsec}(x) = \arccos(1/x)\) لكل \(|x| \ge 1\)؛ وكذلك \(\arcsin x + \arccos x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) و\(\arctan x + \operatorname{arccot} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
